full_name: Anna Schuleit | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2006–2007 Arts David and Roberta Logie Fellow Independent Artist
bio: Anna Schuleit is a visual artist whose large-scale installations revolve around the archaeology and remembrance of public sites and modern ruins.
